Dictionary commonness flags and missing JLPT tags do not establish difficulty or a ban on these numerical expressions.

dispositions.actualChange: Added good 枚/三枚/3枚 and 丁/三丁/3丁; kana まい/さんまい and ちょう/さんちょう; the note distinguishes zaru/mori serving style and restaurant orders and denies fixed size or equal quantities. Added the precise Sanabo soba URL.
dispositions.independentAssessment: These are the contextual alternatives identified in the initial finding. The unchanged Japanese still leaves serving style open. The new note accurately qualifies the alternatives instead of turning them into universally equal units. Canonical 三人前 and its sole Read answer さんにんまえ are unchanged.

dispositions.originalCategory: Consequential uncertainty about one accepted Type alias
dispositions.withdrawalMeaning: The live unsupported-inclusion hold is withdrawn because only the previously unsubstantiated optional alias was removed. This is not a declaration that the original uncertainty was false or that いっぴーす is linguistically invalid.
dispositions.actualChange: Removed only kana いっぴーす; retained all written answers and いちぴーす/ひとぴーす/わんぴーす. Added the Sanabo cake URL. Japanese, English, noun, note, distractors and canonical Read are unchanged.
dispositions.ordinaryAnswerOmissionAssessment: No established ordinary contextual answer has been shown to be omitted by this withdrawal. The actual previously inspected cake sources explicitly support いちぴーす/ひとぴーす and ワンピース; the initial report did not establish comparable usage for いっぴーす. I accept the bounded finite-answer withdrawal, not a phonological ban.
dispositions.gradingConsequence: The removed geminated kana no longer receives its previously authored Type acceptance. Normalization does not erase small っ or turn it into いちぴーす. This consequence was considered rather than described as a metadata-only change.
dispositions.historicalUncertainty: Whether いっぴーす is a genuine ordinary or more restricted alternative in this cake context remains unadjudicated. Absence from the consulted entries does not prove invalidity. If reliable exact evidence establishes an ordinary fitting variant, the current exclusion should be revisited.
dispositions.whyNotAnotherLiveHold: There is no new claim in the note that the removed form is wrong, and no evidence here establishes an ordinary-answer false negative. A finite authored answer set is not required to preserve every formerly hypothesized alias indefinitely. The initial unsupported-inclusion uncertainty therefore need not remain a live correctness hold solely because the speculative form was removed.

dispositions.confidence: High about the exact removal and retention; moderate about the bounded no-established-omission assessment. No confidence claim of linguistic invalidity.

dispositions.requiredResolution: A qualified exact pronunciation/usage judgment for the 三部屋 combinations, with relevant register or variant limits. Do not mechanically generate combinations, reject by source omission, omit this record, or drop its required sound class.
dispositions.newEvidence: None independently inspected during this reconciliation. The proposals' Wiktionary and Stack Exchange navigation receipts were not independently fetched and provide no basis here to close U1.
dispositions.confidence: High that the evidence hold remains unresolved; not a claim that any listed reading is wrong.

initialReviewQuestions: Exact 三部屋 set remains an explicit evidence hold: proposed さんべや/さんへや/みへや are not claimed to come from one inspected full dictionary table. Adjudicate the real compound using actual sources and contextual linguistic judgment, not source omission.
Check each fitting typed alternative in the actual scene, especially serving-style counters, mixed-goods counters, connected fruit clusters and cut tofu pieces.
Check kind versus item counting and all distractors without treating preferred counters as exclusive.
Check food portion 人前 versus recipe/material 人分, whole tofu blocks versus packages/cut pieces, and citrus segments versus fruit bunches.
Check every gloss boundary and the actual prompt operation; no large arithmetic, finance advice, fixed portion mass or medical dosing is intended.
